description: Detect new follows across tracked accounts. Returns temporal diffs - who each tracked account recently followed and when (detected_at per follow). By default returns company-grade signal: follows classified as non-companies are hidden (hidden_non_companies reports the count) and classification labels are attached. Set raw=true for the unfiltered feed. Accounts added very recently appear under "baselining" and are live-checked against X for follows made since they were added.

cursor.description: Opaque watermark from a previous response's next_cursor. Resumes exactly where that run stopped, so a scheduled job that retries neither double counts nor drops records. Overrides since. Pass it back unmodified; save it only AFTER processing the response.

hours.description: Shorthand: hours to look back (e.g. 48). Alternative to since.

include_baseline.description: Include the initial indexed follow lists of accounts still establishing a baseline

only.description: "people" = only individuals (plus follows not classified yet), for people-first sourcing; "all" = unfiltered; default "companies"

raw.description: Return the unfiltered follow feed (default hides non-companies)

scope.description: Whose follows to read: "tracked" (default, your tracked accounts), "network" (the whole Frontrun network, paid Pro plans) or "list:<id>" (one of your lists from frontrun_lists, with its sectors).

since.description: Time window: "24h", "7d", "30d", or ISO date. Default: "24h"

username.description: Filter to a specific tracked account

name: frontrun_new_follows
